verdict.rationale: Evidence shows task/run version locking (docs-7) and API auth gating (probe-rt-4), but no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy for the SDK/API surface; no OpenAPI/versioned spec was found (probe-3 all 404). Community reports even suggest rough, undocumented breaking changes between v3 and v4 (comm-13, comm-19), reinforcing the absence of a clear deprecation policy.
